fact: MICT&PS invited bids for a roughly 397 km backbone fibre route, Juba to Nadapal on the Kenya border, financed by the World Bank under the Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project (Grant E1780).
title: Request for Bids: Capex for Fibre Deployment for Route A-B
publisher: Ministry of Information, Communication Technology and Postal Services (MICT&PS), Project Implementation Unit
